newsitem.title: USA: Minn. mother jailed in death of daughter.
newsitem.headline: Minn. mother jailed in death of daughter.

text.p: A mother of four was jailed Tuesday on charges of beating her 3-year-old daughter to death, allegedly because the toddler gave her a "dirty look" when asked about eating candy without permission.

Police said a Hennepin County grand jury would be presented with evidence that Mildred Irving, 29, abused her daughter Desi by burning her with a lighter and beating her with an extension cord and her fists.
Irving was ordered held on $750,000 bond.

Police said Irving told them she punched Desi in the chest Thursday after her older children told her the girl had taken candy without permission. Police said Irving also said she was jealous of the attention her daughter received from relatives.

Irving told police Desi gave her a "dirty look" that angered her and she picked up the child and began shaking her. The girl's body went limp and Irving spent three fruitless hours "trying to wake her up," police said.
Rigour mortis had set in by the time neighbours called paramedics.

An autopsy revealed Desi had "extensive injuries," including numerous cuts and bruises, a burn mark and roughly 100 scars. The medical examiner also found the girl had suffered "two broken legs, a broken finger and a broken arm." Some of the injuries were healed, "some were healing and others were acute."
Irving had a history of problems and had lost custody of her children after Desi was born, but completed treatment for alcohol abuse and regained custody.
